changelog: 1.0.1: Apple's Japanese store for Japanese titles and J-pop/anime artists, your own country's store first (Slovak artists have more videos in SK/CZ) then US, and every part of a title counts ("うっせぇわ - Usseewa", "강남스타일 (Gangnam Style)"). Songs without a video are looked at again.
description: Finds every song's official music video ahead of time (a 30-second HD preview from Apple Music) for Triptych's Now Playing canvas. Adds an Apple Music Video ID to songs, editable in Edit Metadata.
name: Triptych Music Video Data
overview: Music videos for Triptych's Now Playing
